Appletun

Grass Dragon

Galar · Generation 8

Appletun is a Grass/Dragon-type Apple Nectar Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 13 kg. It evolves from Applin. Its highest base stat is HP (110), with a base stat total of 485.
